svg.aria-label: A camera seen from the side: the lens, the middle of the film and the film's top edge make a right triangle, with focalLength as the side along the axis (the near side) and half the verticalAperture as the far side. The angle theta at the lens is half the vertical field of view, the same angle at which light from the scene crosses at the lens.
